library.kw_085:r_77b55be7b810a172.text:
A military-industrial complex said to have existed since the dawn of recorded history, wielding powerful influence over politics. It is made up of merchants of death who have secretly manipulated wars and reconstructions to reap enormous profits.
It served as the backing organization for $$ブルーコスモス$$, guiding public opinion to provoke war between the $$地球連合$$ and the Coordinators. $$ブルーコスモス$$'s Muruta Azrael and Lord Djibril were also members of $$ロゴス$$.
After $$デュランダル$$ later exposed its existence and deeds, most of its members were arrested or killed by lynch mobs of enraged citizens. Djibril, the last one remaining, was shot down along with the ship he was aboard, and $$ロゴス$$ was destroyed.

library.kw_085:r_9a7a6796ef8e2728.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$ ascended to the throne as Emperor of Britannia, taking hold of the entire world.
Now going by his real name, $$ルルーシュ$$ vi Britannia, he fought and crushed everything in his path, including his older half-brother Schneizel el Britannia, who refused to accept his methods, and the Black Knights, his former comrades.
His rule by force drew hatred from all over the world, and $$ルルーシュ$$ was struck down and met his end at the hands of a masked man who suddenly appeared: Zero.
The true identity of the Zero who struck down $$ルルーシュ$$ was his sworn friend $$枢木スザク$$. Wishing for a better tomorrow, the two of them had decided from the very start to gather all the world's hatred onto $$ルルーシュ$$ and then strike him down.
This plan, the 'Zero Requiem,' was completed with $$ルルーシュ$$'s death, and the world welcomed a new era.

library.kw_085:r_bee73f3f5b449f0c.text:
A space colony that served as Neo Zeon's base during the Second Neo Zeon War.
Originally a colony built to house refugees, it has a distinctive shape combining open and sealed structures.

library.kw_085:r_c26f97c0f5b3253c.text:
Japan, defeated by the Holy Britannian Empire and turned into its 11th colonial Area.
It is pronounced 'Area Eleven.'
The Japanese were stripped of their names and language, and Britannia refers to them as Elevens. However, Japanese who swear loyalty to Britannia become Honorary Britannians and are granted a certain degree of rights.

library.kw_085:r_30554622a06d59c5.text:
A girl serving as a body double for $$ラクス・クライン$$, who had vanished from public view.
She was discovered by $$デュランダル$$, who believed a figure was needed to captivate the public.
Having undergone plastic surgery, her appearance and singing voice were an exact match for the real $$ラクス$$.
Being a huge fan of $$ラクス$$ herself, her calls for peace and her singing voice moved the hearts of many.
Later, one of $$デュランダル$$'s attendants took advantage of her unstable state of mind, born of the fear that she was no longer needed, and manipulated her into trying to kill the real $$ラクス$$. However, $$ラクス$$'s own words made her realize her mistake, and she threw herself in front of an assassin's bullet meant for $$ラクス$$, dying in her arms.

library.kw_085:r_a4bad97325a13c41.text:
An organization on Earth that supports the Earth Federation resistance group $$エゥーゴ$$.
It not only supports $$エゥーゴ$$'s units when they advance into the atmosphere, but also maintains its own fighting force and battles the $$ティターンズ$$.
$$隼人$$ Kobayashi, who had served aboard the White Base during the $$一年戦争$$, commands its front-line forces, and $$アムロ・レイ$$ also joined $$カラバ$$ after escaping Federation surveillance.

library.kw_085:r_bf5929468c4d7c95.text:
The repair, by the will of a Singularity, of a world's abnormal dimensional boundary conditions (either an unstable state or an extreme, fixed state) born from a $$時空震動$$, or of the very nature of the world itself.
Depending on the case, it can bring about major changes across the entire multiverse.
The person or object that had the greatest influence on the occurrence of a $$時空震動$$ becomes a Singularity. Because the will of the people present at the time is involved in a $$時空震動$$, for convenience such a person is called a Singularity, while the space or location that served as the point of origin for the $$時空震動$$ is called a Great Singularity.

library.kw_085:r_aa87cbd93b628223.text:
His full name is $$カルロス$$ Axion Jr.
He was originally the president of the Axion Foundation, once the largest corporate group in the world, but during the $$破界事変$$ he threw the world into chaos as a sponsor of the $$新帝国インペリウム$$. After the $$破界事変$$ ended, he secured his freedom through a plea deal in which he provided all the information he had, and settled into a position as a management advisor at Scort Labo.
He had an enigmatic personality; as head of the Foundation he tried to solve everything with money, but he merely used his financial power as a tool at his disposal, and never showed arrogance or conceit.
He wished from the bottom of his heart for the world to change, and in the $$再世戦争$$ he cooperated with the resurrected $$ガイオウ$$, though he never wished for the world's destruction.

library.kw_085:r_486d6dd3449e1a6d.text:
The organization at the center of the $$破界事変$$.
With $$ガイオウ$$, the King of Destruction who appeared through the $$時空震動$$ called Calamity Birth that occurred in Limonesia, as its ruler, it declared war on the entire world.
Its major members included the strategist $$アイム$$ Liard, Chief Administrator Sionie Regis, and its sponsor, $$カルロス$$ Axion Jr.
Using Dimensional Beasts as its main fighting force, it plunged the whole world into chaos, but after $$ガイオウ$$, the King of Destruction, was defeated, the organization was destroyed.
The disorder and threat it caused became the catalyst for the birth of the Earth Federation.

library.kw_085:r_1e33411f441fd9b0.text:
An independent peacekeeping force within the Earth Federation Forces.
It holds extralegal authority exceeding that of the regular military, and is given priority for the deployment of the latest equipment.
Acting under the will of Ribbons Almark, the $$イノベイド$$ who sought to control humanity, it suppressed small nations and resistance movements that defied the Earth Federation. Later, it went on to gain full command authority over the regular military as well.
When Celestial Being achieved victory over the Innovades, the Earth Federation Forces were reorganized, and $$アロウズ$$ was disbanded.

library.kw_085:r_8725681dfb9a802b.text:
A quantum computing system that forms the foundation of Aeolia Schoenberg's plan.
Possessing information-processing power beyond comparison with ordinary computers, it was a great source of strength enabling Celestial Being to fight against the entire world.
However, with Ribbons Almark's cooperation, $$ヴェーダ$$ was seized by $$アレハンドロ・コーナー$$, and after his death it fell into Ribbons's hands.
Its main body is located inside the mothership Celestial Being.

library.kw_085:r_11b3e6618f6a5a19.text:
A massive deep-space vessel, 15 kilometers long, built from an asteroid base.
It serves as the Innovades' base of operations and carries the main body of the quantum computing system $$ヴェーダ$$.
Even now that it has come under the Earth Federation's control, its sheer size means its functions and facilities have yet to be fully grasped, and analysis of its various sections is still ongoing.

library.kw_085:r_6dffc48d8d0db88c.text:
Special individuals who possess knowledge of technologies not yet developed within the current body of technical knowledge.
These technologies, which by rights should not exist, are called Black Technology, and depending on how they are used, they can completely overturn the current military balance. For this reason, various organizations have schemed to capture the $$ウィスパード$$, and $$ミスリル$$ acts to protect them.

library.kw_085:r_f05ddb00f5aa9850.text:
Special individuals who possess knowledge of technologies not yet developed within the current body of technical knowledge.
These technologies, which by rights should not exist, are called Black Technology, and depending on how they are used, they can completely overturn the current military balance. For this reason, various organizations have schemed to capture the $$ウィスパード$$, and $$ミスリル$$ acts to protect them.
Black Technology manifests in a $$ウィスパード$$'s mind at some chance trigger, as though someone were whispering to them, but the system and cause behind this phenomenon remain unexplained.
The Lambda Driver is likewise a product of Black Technology brought forth by a $$ウィスパード$$.
At present, $$テレサ・テスタロッサ$$ and $$千鳥かなめ$$ are known to be $$ウィスパード$$, and it is considered all but certain that $$ウィスパード$$ exist within Amalgam as well.

library.kw_085:r_33d3b382021a1721.text:
An isolated island that is home to the base of $$ミスリル$$'s Western Pacific fleet.
Located at 20 degrees 50 minutes north latitude and 140 degrees 31 minutes east longitude, it has a tropical climate, and most of the island is covered in dense jungle.

library.kw_085:r_827e334dda22618c.text:
Mysterious life forms that appeared from another dimension between the $$破界事変$$ and the $$再世戦争$$.
Their official name, 'Dimension-Armed MONster,' was abbreviated to Damon, but once multiple types were confirmed, the Axion Foundation's Institute for Extradimensional Life Research, ADiCR (the A-DiC Institute), carried out a new classification of names.
Their true nature is a form in which a mobile weapon and its pilot's life have been fused together by the effect of the Revive Cells generated by $$ガイオウ$$, the King of Destruction. Through Dimensional Beastification (= Violation), combat strength rises dramatically. Dimensional Beasts also have ranks, and depending on the original unit, pilot, and combat strength, they transform into one class or another.
It is impossible to restore a Dimensional-Beastified unit and pilot to their original state, and the pilot's consciousness is basically extinguished. For this reason there is no way to communicate with a $$次元獣$$, but they obey $$ガイオウ$$'s orders and act in an organized manner under his command.
ADiCR is the authority on $$次元獣$$ research, and it was here that the name Damon was coined. However, much of the data brought here by Foundation president $$カルロス$$ Axion Jr. was in fact collected by the Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$, a nation on a parallel-world Earth that had previously been destroyed by Dimensional Beasts, and the names of the various classes are also ones that were used in $$インサラウム$$.

library.kw_085:r_9d0fbd1535ca6982.text:
A holder of a $$スフィア$$.
The term does not simply mean the pilot of a unit equipped with a $$スフィア$$, but refers to a person capable of drawing out a $$スフィア$$'s power.

library.kw_085:r_ca0827382889c7eb.text:
A holder of a $$スフィア$$.
The term does not simply mean the pilot of a unit equipped with a $$スフィア$$, but refers to a person capable of drawing out a $$スフィア$$'s power.
From the words of $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$, who called himself a Third Stage, it can be inferred that Reactors have stages corresponding to the level of $$スフィア$$ power they can draw out. It also appears that at the Third Stage or higher, a person can draw out a $$スフィア$$'s power and produce some kind of effect even without being aboard a unit.

library.kw_085:r_d45c2bc6669a87e3.text:
His full name is $$ユーサー$$ $$インサラウム$$.
He is the first prince of the Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$.
He is the biological son of the previous king, King $$インサラウム$$ LXXII, and although he has not yet ascended the throne, he will become the ruler of $$インサラウム$$ after the 72nd king's death.
Gentle, thoughtful, and overflowing with compassion, he was beloved by his people.
That love awakens the $$スフィア$$ known as the $$尽きぬ水瓶$$, carried aboard The Insar, the sacred royal unit passed down in $$インサラウム$$.
Knowingly accepting disgrace upon himself, he took on the entire responsibility for the invasion of Earth and fought, ending the war through his own defeat. He further had the people accepted by Earth by making them out to be victims of his own tyranny, and entrusted $$インサラウム$$'s future to $$マルグリット$$.

library.kw_085:r_691105b85983875e.text:
A mysterious agent of destruction who appeared in $$ＡＤＷ$$ through Project Uzume, which opens a door to another dimension using Spacequakes.
He destroyed the Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$ on a parallel-world Earth, and there met $$アイム$$ Liard, whom he made his strategist. In $$インサラウム$$ he was called the King of Destruction, but after transferring to $$ＡＤＷ$$, he began calling himself $$ガイオウ$$ at $$カルロス$$ Axion Jr.'s suggestion.
At the time of the $$破界事変$$, he had lost his memory, forgetting his real name, origin, and purpose entirely, but driven by the one sense of mission that remained, he sought out strong opponents and spread battle across the world. In the course of those battles he gradually regained his memories, and on the other moon, the Shadow Moon, he fully awakened to his true mission, though he refused to speak of it.
His true identity is a being known as a Dimensional General, whose mission is to organize an army of Dimensional Beasts in order to fight some unknown enemy. Even while harboring doubts about his own existence and mission, he devoted his life to battle, living and fighting to the very end as his soul commanded.
It was also said, from his own words, that there are four Dimensional Generals in total who are presumed to share the same mission.
His favorite foods are fast food in general, especially hot dogs.

library.kw_085:r_a900b7fc5fe27158.text:
The endpoint of a phenomenon in which the flow of absolute time for living things approaches zero.
A phenomenon that occurs within a world cut off by a dimensional wall known as the 'Prison of Time.' Once $$エタニティ・フラット$$ is complete, time within living things comes to a stop, and aging also ceases. However, human growth and childbirth also cease to occur.
Food shortages are anticipated as the growth of animals and plants stops, but above all, since stagnation as a species and 'death' itself do not disappear, it is predicted that humanity will gradually go extinct.

library.kw_085:r_09a1dede93746d50.text:
The endpoint of a phenomenon in which the flow of absolute time for living things approaches zero.
A phenomenon that occurs within a world cut off by a dimensional wall known as the 'Prison of Time.' Once $$エタニティ・フラット$$ is complete, time within living things comes to a stop, and aging also ceases. However, human growth and childbirth also cease to occur.
Food shortages are anticipated as the growth of animals and plants stops, but above all, since stagnation as a species and 'death' itself do not disappear, it is predicted that humanity will gradually go extinct.
However, because $$エタニティ・フラット$$ occurs within a world isolated by the fixing of its dimensional boundary, it was believed that the fixed boundary's restriction of hyperspace navigation would prevent $$バアル$$'s onslaught.
People all over the world were left to choose between the slow extinction brought by $$エタニティ・フラット$$ or a war against $$バアル$$, and as a result of that choice, the Prison of Time was destroyed through $$時空修復$$, and $$エタニティ・フラット$$ was averted.
It remains unknown who isolated Earth's dimension, or for what purpose.
